predict.question: Your new computer can calculate 16 jobs per step, but its input only feeds it 4 jobs per step. How many jobs per step does it finish?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Computation depends on how components communicate and operate together.
modelBoundary: The original gives {A}; faster arithmetic still gives {B}. Input cannot supply work fast enough to use the extra calculation capacity.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This ideal serial limit is exact inside the toy. It does not model a brain or machine parallelism.
